info.name: Bella Vista Italian Trattoria
info.hours: Monday–Thursday: 11:30 AM – 9:30 PM | Friday–Saturday: 11:30 AM – 10:30 PM | Sunday: 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM
info.payment: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Cash (No personal checks).
info.reservations: Recommended for parties of 5 or more via OpenTable or phone. 15-minute grace period before table release.
info.takeout: Online curbside takeout available. Delivery supported via DoorDash and Uber Eats within an 8-mile radius.
info.parking: Complimentary 2-hour parking in rear garage with validation stamp; street metered parking available.
info.dress: Smart casual dress required. No sleeveless athletic shirts, swimwear, or bare feet permitted.
info.alcohol: Full bar available. Valid government-issued 21+ ID required. Corkage fee is $25 per 750ml bottle (maximum 2 bottles).

items.name: Classic Bruschetta
items.description: Toasted rustic ciabatta topped with diced Roma tomatoes, fresh basil, garlic, extra virgin olive oil, and aged balsamic glaze.

items.name: Crispy Calamari Fritti
items.description: Wild-caught squid lightly dusted in seasoned semolina flour, flash-fried, served with house marinara and lemon-caper aioli.

items.name: Caprese Salad
items.description: Thick slices of fresh buffalo mozzarella, vine-ripened heirloom tomatoes, sweet basil leaves, coarse sea salt, and aged balsamic reduction.

items.name: Stuffed Portobello Caps
items.description: Oven-roasted portobello mushrooms stuffed with sweet Italian sausage, breadcrumbs, herbs, and melted fontina cheese.

items.name: Garlic Herb Focaccia
items.description: House-baked rosemary and sea salt focaccia served warm with whipped roasted garlic parmesan butter.

items.name: Prosciutto-Wrapped Asparagus
items.description: Fresh jumbo asparagus spears wrapped in 18-month aged Prosciutto di Parma, grilled and finished with lemon zest.

items.name: Arancini Siciliani
items.description: Crispy golden risotto balls stuffed with bolognese meat sauce, sweet peas, and smoked mozzarella, served over tomato coulis.

items.name: Steamed Mediterranean Mussels
items.description: PEI mussels steamed in a broth of pinot grigio, shallots, garlic, crushed red pepper flakes, and fresh parsley with grilled bread.

items.name: Truffle Whipped Ricotta
items.description: Creamy house-made whole milk ricotta whipped with black truffle oil and wildflower honey, served with toasted crostini.

items.name: Beef Carpaccio
items.description: Thinly sliced raw beef tenderloin, baby arugula, shaved Parmigiano-Reggiano, capers, and a drizzle of white truffle olive oil.

items.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
items.description: Traditional pasta tossed with crisp guanciale, farm-fresh egg yolks, Pecorino Romano cheese, and freshly cracked black peppercorn.

items.name: Fettuccine Alfredo con Pollo
items.description: House-made egg fettuccine tossed in a rich butter, garlic, and Parmigiano-Reggiano cream sauce, topped with grilled chicken breast.

items.name: Classic Lasagna Bolognese
items.description: Layered fresh pasta sheets with slow-simmered beef and pork ragù, creamy bechamel, ricotta, and melted mozzarella.

items.name: Penne alla Vodka
items.description: Penne pasta tossed in a velvety tomato-cream sauce with crushed red pepper, finished with fresh sweet peas and shaved parmesan.

items.name: Chicken Parmigiana
items.description: Breaded crispy chicken cutlet baked with rustic tomato sauce, melted mozzarella, served alongside garlic spaghetti.

items.name: Chicken Piccata
items.description: Pan-seared chicken breast simmered in a white wine, lemon juice, butter, and caper sauce over angel hair pasta.

items.name: Chicken Marsala
items.description: Tender chicken scallopini sautéed with wild cremini mushrooms in a rich sweet Marsala wine reduction with whipped potatoes.

items.name: Veal Saltimbocca
items.description: Tender veal cutlets topped with fresh sage and prosciutto, sautéed in white wine butter sauce, served with roasted fingerling potatoes.

items.name: Veal Parmigiana
items.description: Tender breaded milk-fed veal cutlet baked with San Marzano marinara sauce and fresh provolone, served over linguine.

items.name: Eggplant Rollatini
items.description: Thinly sliced roasted eggplant rolled with seasoned ricotta and spinach, baked under marinara sauce and mozzarella cheese.

items.name: Gnocchi Sorrentina
items.description: Hand-rolled potato gnocchi baked in a San Marzano tomato sauce with fresh basil, topped with bubbling melted mozzarella.

items.name: Lobster Ravioli
items.description: Jumbo ravioli stuffed with North Atlantic lobster and ricotta, finished in a sherry saffron tomato cream reduction with sautéed cherry tomatoes.

items.name: Linguine alle Vongole
items.description: Manila clams steamed in garlic, white wine, extra virgin olive oil, and red pepper flakes over a bed of linguine pasta.

items.name: Grilled Chilean Sea Bass
items.description: Pan-roasted sea bass fillet served over creamy saffron risotto and topped with warm olive and caper tapenade.

items.name: Pan-Seared Salmon Piccante
items.description: Wild Atlantic salmon fillet seared crispy, glazed with a spicy Calabrian chili and orange glaze, served with sautéed broccolini.

items.name: Shrimp Fra Diavolo
items.description: Jumbo black tiger shrimp simmered in a spicy garlic marinara sauce over fettuccine with fresh torn basil.

items.name: Cioppino Seafood Stew
items.description: Hearty seafood stew featuring clams, mussels, shrimp, and white fish in a fennel-scented tomato-wine broth with garlic crostini.

items.name: Osso Buco alla Milanese
items.description: Slow-braised veal shank in vegetable and white wine broth, served over classic saffron risotto and finished with gremolata.

items.name: Grilled Prime Ribeye 14 oz
items.description: USDA Prime ribeye steak grilled with rosemary butter, served with truffle parmesan roasted potatoes and asparagus.

items.name: Beef Short Rib Ragu
items.description: Boneless beef short rib braised for 8 hours in Chianti wine, shredded over wide pappardelle ribbons with shaved pecorino.

items.name: Wild Mushroom Risotto
items.description: Slow-cooked Arborio rice with porcini, shiitake, and cremini mushrooms, finished with butter, white truffle oil, and parmesan.

items.name: Pistachio-Crusted Lamb Chops
items.description: Grilled lamb chops crusted with crushed pistachios, served with garlic mash and a rosemary red wine reduction.

items.name: Margherita Pizza
items.description: Wood-fired thin crust pizza topped with San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella di bufala, basil, and extra virgin olive oil.

items.name: Quattro Formaggi Pizza
items.description: Hand-tossed pizza base with roasted garlic olive oil, mozzarella, gorgonzola dolce, fontina, and parmigiano-reggiano.

items.name: Tuscan Braised Pork Chop
items.description: Thick bone-in heritage pork chop pan-roasted with sweet peppers, onions, and garlic in a light balsamic jus.

items.name: Classic Tiramisu
items.description: Espresso-soaked ladyfingers layered with sweet mascarpone cream, dusted with dark Dutch cocoa powder.

items.name: Sicilian Cannoli Trio
items.description: Crispy pastry shells filled with sweet whipped ricotta, mini chocolate chips, and crushed pistachios.

items.name: Vanilla Bean Panna Cotta
items.description: Chilled silky sweet cream custard infused with Madagascar vanilla beans, topped with a fresh strawberry-basil compote.

items.name: Molten Chocolate Lava Cake
items.description: Rich dark chocolate cake with a molten center, served with a scoop of vanilla bean gelato.

items.name: Lemon Ricotta Cheesecake
items.description: Light and airy baked cheesecake infused with fresh lemon zest and limoncello, with a graham cracker crust.

items.name: San Pellegrino Sparkling Water 750ml
items.description: Crisp natural mineral sparkling water served chilled with lemon or lime slice.

items.name: San Pellegrino Aranciata
items.description: Sparkling Italian orange soda made with real Mediterranean fruit juice.

items.name: Freshly Brewed Iced Tea
items.description: Classic unsweetened black tea brewed daily, served with fresh lemon.

items.name: Classic Italian Espresso
items.description: Rich and bold single or double shot of dark roast espresso with golden crema.

items.name: Vanilla Bean Cappuccino
items.description: Steamed milk and espresso topped with dense foam, dusted with cinnamon and vanilla bean powder.

items.name: Classic Aperol Spritz
items.description: Aperol liqueur, crisp Prosecco, and a splash of club soda, served over ice with a fresh orange slice.

items.name: Negroni Classico
items.description: Equal parts London Dry gin, Campari bitter, and sweet red vermouth, served on the rocks with an orange peel.

items.name: Pinot Grigio delle Venezie Glass
